name: How do you remove the smoke smell from furniture and personal belongings?

mainEntity.name: How do you remove the smoke smell from furniture and personal belongings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Removing smoke smell from furniture and personal belongings requires specialized techniques. Porous items like upholstery, drapes, and clothing often need professional cleaning, sometimes involving ozone treatments or industrial-grade deodorizers. Non-porous items are typically cleaned and deodorized by hand. Some items, particularly those with deep smoke saturation, may be unsalvageable. Each item is assessed individually to determine the most effective and safe restoration method.
acceptedAnswer.description: Smoke smell is removed from furniture and belongings using professional cleaning, ozone treatments, or industrial deodorizers, with methods varying by item type.
